# Rowan

This private rabbit hole follows Rowan’s move from the family flat to a room above a bakery in Bellwick. A later recollection and three posts follow the room from its first evening through a borrowed table and a winter desk, with the yellow mug and paper flowers still part of the account.

Start with [Rowan’s introduction and reading route](00_Entry/Start.md), or go straight to [The yellow mug on the windowsill](30_Stories/Chapters/The%20yellow%20mug%20on%20the%20windowsill.md).
